messages.content: Predict the distribution of responses from participants in Mixed Messages, a generative art project. These are this audience's interpretations, not objective labels. Reply with a single JSON object only. No prose or code fences.

WORD: "STEVE JOBS"

Estimate the share of this audience's submissions in each quadrant:
performed+uniting: creating false unity among us
honest+uniting: bringing us together, authentically
performed+dividing: exploiting our divisions, deliberately
honest+dividing: fracturing us, truthfully

Return exactly these four keys with numeric probabilities between 0 and 1 that sum to 1 (not percentages). Use at least three decimal places when needed. A sum differing from 1 by at most 0.001 will be normalized. Do not include confidence, explanations, or any other keys.
{"performed+uniting": <probability>, "honest+uniting": <probability>, "performed+dividing": <probability>, "honest+dividing": <probability>}

message.reasoning:
The task: predict distribution of audience interpretations for the word "STEVE JOBS" in a generative art project called "Mixed Messages". The quadrants are about performed vs honest, uniting vs dividing.

Steve Jobs: polarizing figure. Some see him as a visionary who brought technology together ("bringing us together, authentically" — honest+uniting), others see him as a marketing genius who created false unity through branding/cult of Apple ("performed+uniting"), some see him as divisive (reality distortion field, harsh management, "think different" elitism). Dividing interpretations: performed+dividing (exploiting divisions deliberately — marketing that creates tribalism Apple vs Android, planned obsolescence, elitism), honest+dividing (truthfully fracturing — his honest critiques, brutal honesty, telling people what they need).

Audience interpretations likely skew toward "performed" because Steve Jobs is strongly associated with performance, showmanship, keynotes, marketing, "reality distortion field". The uniting vs dividing: Apple's brand created community but also tribalism. Many would say performed+uniting (false unity through branding, "Think Different" ads creating an illusion of unity/individuality). Some would say honest+uniting (he genuinely brought technology to people, connected the world). Dividing: performed+dividing (deliberately exploiting divisions, us-vs-them Apple vs PC, elitism, consumerism). Honest+dividing (his brutal honesty, telling hard truths, fracturing but truthfully).

My estimate: performed+uniting highest, maybe 0.40. honest+uniting ~0.25. performed+dividing ~0.22. honest+dividing ~0.13. Sum = 1.000.

Let me refine: 0.40, 0.26, 0.21, 0.13 = 1.00. Good.
